newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta Bank of Valletta Intl lifts profit to $6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Malta Bank of Valletta Intl lifts profit to $6 mln.

text.p: Bank of Valletta International (BOVI), a subsidiary of Malta's Bank of Valletta Group, made a net profit before tax of $6.03 million in the year that ended on September 30.
Group chairman John Grech said on Tuesday profit was up 29.5 percent from the $4.66 million registered the previous year. BOVI's total assets increased by $49 million to $352.36 million.

Competitive pressures had temporarily forced some deposit and lending margins to narrow but this impact was well counterbalanced by growth in activity in a number of successful niche business opportunities, Grech said.
